construction_tests.runtime: CPython 3.14.5 macOS arm64, standard library only

input.source: A01 candidate raw from commit 5e23f00fb98e24c078077ba4869a292d4120f7ab; exact-byte copy

metrics: four cell summaries for development accuracy, fresh accuracy and optimism
seed-paired FULL minus CONTROLLED contrasts within each update rule
seed-paired CASE_PATCH minus STRATUM_PATCH contrasts within each feedback mode
seed-paired difference-in-differences, CASE_PATCH feedback effect minus STRATUM_PATCH feedback effect
for each finite vector: mean, median, min, max, and positive/zero/negative counts
mutations: exact raw row count and factorial seed/cell frame
analysis output altered cell, contrast, interaction, input digest, or row count
type: saved-data analysis only; no candidate simulation
container: not required by Issue #8319 for pure finite CPU analysis; no isolation claim
hypothesis_limit: finite authored simulator only; no population inference, p-value, or general researcher feedback claim
